name: Iron hydroxide polymaltose complex
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.indication: Iron deficiency and iron-deficiency anemia (adults, adolescents over 12, pregnancy)
usual_adult_dose.dose: 100 to 300 mg iron daily (1 to 3 chewable tablets), with or after meals

key_interactions.effect: No significant reduction in iron absorption (studies).

contraindications: Iron-utilization disorders (lead anemia, sideroachrestic anemia, thalassemia)
Anemia not due to iron deficiency

pk.bioavailability: Absorbed actively in duodenum and jejunum; relative absorption falls with dose and rises with deficiency; not reduced by food
pk.metabolism: Iron incorporated into hemoglobin or stored as ferritin
pk.excretion_renal_pct: Not renal; unabsorbed iron in feces

sources.citation: Vifor France. (2022). Maltofer 100 mg tuggtabletter (iron(III) hydroxide polymaltose complex) [Produktresumé (summary of product characteristics); revised December 28, 2022]. Swedish Medical Products Agency (Läkemedelsverket).
